title: GeomInstanceAPI
summary: Native-instancing tag on an instance root. ovstage population writes it into usd-schemas of every instance root, whose usd-prim-type becomes XformInstance (or ScopeInstance) while the authored type moves to usd-metadata:typeName.
producer_scope: Written by ovstage population on every instance root, in every domain.
notes: No USD schema applies this name and it declares no column; the parser keys native instancing on the ovstage instancing queries (instance and prototype roots), not on attributes.
